title: person
description: An author and/or narrator. Authors and narrators are the same entity type; a person can be both.

kind.description: What sort of entity this record names. ABSENCE MEANS "person" - the field exists to mark the records that are not one: a group credited as a unit (a full cast, a band), a corporate credit of record (a publisher's in-house imprint), or a synthetic voice - a text-to-speech production rather than an individual. Nothing infers the first three; a record only carries one when a human classified it, so an absent value is 'unclassified or an individual', never a guess. "synthetic" is the one exception: the importer writes it on the single canonical record every AI-narration credit folds onto.
